findings.title: judgment page prints the consumed-attempt counter as `attempt:`, off by one against the kernel's own numbering (`attempt: 0` on a first attempt)

`orchid notify --choice` accepts a value starting with `-`, which `orchid answer` can never take as a positional — a declared but unanswerable choice (the broker path is safe via `is_id`; the direct CLI is not)
notify's new flag loop refuses any text argument beginning with `-` and offers no `--` end-of-options escape, where `orchid notify "-x is broken"` previously minted a blocker
`docs/specs/operations.md:249` still enumerates `orchid answer`'s gates as "nonce, sender allowlist, and expiry" and omits the new declared-choice-set refusal
